passage.t: The polar ice caps continually shrink and expand. Warmer

resources. As part of the Arctic Observing Network, NASA has been conducting research for more than 20 years to better understand the health of the region. The satellite record goes back to 1978 and includes important information such as ice cover, sea surface temperature and sea ice concentrations.

tasks.analysis: The polar ice caps continually shrink and expand. Warmer than normal temperatures have been reported in the Arctic, as have related changes in glaciers, sea ice and marine resources. As part of the Arctic Observing Network, NASA has been conducting research for more than 20 years to better understand the health of the region. The satellite record goes back to 1978 and includes important information such as ice cover, sea surface temperature and sea ice concentrations. 极地冰盖在不断地缩小和扩张。据报告，北极地区出现了高于正常水平的气温，冰川、海冰和海洋资源也发生了相关变化。作为北极观测网络的一部分，美国国家航空航天局（NASA）已开展了 20 多年的研究，以更好地了解该地区的生态状况。卫星观测记录可追溯至 1978 年，其中包含冰盖覆盖范围、海面温度和海冰浓度等重要信息。
